capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: Sierra EV Standard Range pack 119 kWh; Weekly Driver 14-module Ultium truck pack 119 kWh as published (no usable/gross split).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Weekly Driver: 14-module pack ~470 V nominal as published; GM spec guide 475 V up to 220 kW; Silverado EV Standard Range recorded 400 V class.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Same 14-module pack as the Silverado EV Standard Range: GM spec guide 475 V up to 220 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Silverado EV Standard Range 11.5 kW charging module (GM spec guide); Wikipedia lists 19.2 kW as the Sierra EV maximum (ER/Max).
